details:
Since I am not sure if I can retake the feedback email I thought of some more feedback to give to VRChat staff on what I think would improve the platform going forward.

In no particular order, this is a list of things I have noticed are either missing or would be useful going forward. Most of these are QOL improvements for creators and community leaders, also some may be repeated from other posts.

- Content gated groups.

- Content gated instances.

- Bug report directly in the unity sdk.

- VIP Creator feedback (To verify feedback given to high level creators directly to the vrchat team that isn't a random email that looks suspicious)

- Text (optional voice) messaging system.

- Ability to hot patch private avatar name/descriptions from the website like you can with worlds.

- World available gui in the main user ui system that can be programmed by world devs (I know this one was worked on and a prototype exists though no news has come from it recently.)

- Ability to download a copy of your own world/avatar from the website (Reduction in ripping would be a result if the user who uploaded the content can just download it again assuming they never made a backup, I would recommend that better security be set up first before this is available in case of account breach)

- Friends only instances having a warning that the person that is being sent an invite from a invite request is not a friend of the instance owner and the invite has been lost.

- Option to keep your own avatar loaded through load screens to reduce the processing need to unload and reload your own avatar through instance switching.

(If I think of more I will edit this post, or if there is a better way doing this I am open to suggestions)
title: A List of Potential QOL Improvements.
